summary.text: Clint Anderson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 45 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Clinton Anderson was born in Beloit, Wisconsin, where he lives, and graduated from Beloit Memorial High School in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned an associate degree from the University of Wisconsin, Rock County, in 2016 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Whitewater, in 2018.

Anderson worked as a volunteer coordinator and shelter advocate for the YWCA Rock County and as a youth support specialist at Professional Services Group, served on the board of Beloit Meals on Wheels, and was elected to the Beloit City Council.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had served on the Beloit City Council since 2017 and had been its vice-president and president.

Anderson was assigned to the Campaigns and Elections Committee, the Local Government Committee, the Rural Development Committee and the Joint Legislative Council Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
